description: Promet na mejnih prehodih od leta 2019 dalje is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA NOTRANJE ZADEVE POLICIJA. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic at border crossing points from 2019 onwards" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA NOTRANJE ZADEVE POLICIJA. Its keywords include mejni prehodi, meja. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
